description: Run Flowise in Docker bound to loopback 127.0.0.1:3000 (data in the Docker volume "flowise"). It reaches the host Ollama via host.docker.internal — set Ollama node Base URL to http://host.docker.internal:11434 inside Flowise (no cloud key).

steps.description: Make sure the AI Chat plugin's Ollama is running on 127.0.0.1:11434 (start it if installed). Install the AI Chat plugin first if this reports it missing.
steps.run: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; if command -v ollama >/dev/null 2>&1; then export OLLAMA_HOST=127.0.0.1:11434; nohup ollama serve >/tmp/ollama.log 2>&1 & for i in $(seq 1 20); do curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/version >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; sleep 1; done; fi; echo "Ollama not reachable on 127.0.0.1:11434 — install/run the AI Chat plugin first (it sets up Ollama with no root)."

steps.description: Start the Flowise container bound to loopback 127.0.0.1:3000 (data persisted in the Docker volume "flowise").
steps.run: docker rm -f flowise 2>/dev/null || true; docker run -d --name flowise --restart unless-stopped -p 127.0.0.1:3000:3000 --add-host=host.docker.internal:host-gateway -v flowise:/root/.flowise flowiseai/flowise
for i in $(seq 1 60); do curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3000/ >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; sleep 2; done; echo "Flowise still starting — give it a moment."

uninstall.description: Stop and remove the Flowise container and its data volume.
uninstall.run: docker rm -f flowise 2>/dev/null || true; docker volume rm flowise 2>/dev/null || true
